Historic Zoar Village

Historic Zoar Village is a must-see destination in Ohio for anyone interested in history, art, or architecture.

Event & Tour Tickets

Visit

Explore

Experience

Events

Membership

Help us preserve our past and secure our future by becoming a member of the Zoar Community Association.

Donate

We rely on your donations to fund our preservation and restoration efforts. Consider donating today. Any amount helps.

Volunteer

Volunteers are the heart of our village - without them, we would not be able to share our history and traditions.

Weddings & Rentals

Historic Zoar Village offers a picturesque setting for the special milestones in your life! Many couples choose the Zoar Garden as a serene, intimate spot to exchange their wedding nuptials. With flowers in bloom and the unique architecture of the Garden House as the backdrop, guests always remember Zoar Weddings for years to come.
Learn More

Zoar Store

Support Zoar when you shop Historic Zoar Village's General Store! Pottery, candles, books, soaps, socks, cards, clothes and more are available at the village or online. The store offers unique gifts and fare from local businesses sure to delight. Shop for yourself or a loved one.
Shop Online Now

Genealogy

Find your personal connection to Zoar. Explore our Genealogy page for information on Zoar family history. Genealogical resources include photographs, census records, and family trees.

Museum Schedule

Jan-Mar: Closed
Apr-May: Sat (11am-4pm); Sun (12pm-4pm)
Jun-Sep: Wed-Sat (11am-4pm); Sun (12pm-4pm)
Oct: Sat (11am-4pm); Sun (12pm-4pm)
Nov-Dec: Closed

Tour Times

ZOAR STORE HOURS

Jan-Feb: Closed
Mar-Dec: Wed-Sat (10am-5pm); Sun (12pm-5pm)

Please note our office is closed on Mondays. The museum and store are closed on all major holidays.

Historic Zoar Village is operated by the Zoar Community Association.
